name: Blood & Sherry
source:
You've woken up in a strange manor. You've been offered servants' clothing to wear. The lord of the manor is a vampire who seeks to make you his "dinner guest". Between him and his combative butler, you have your hands full trying to survive the night!

[From [url=https://karmic-punishment.itch.io/blood-and-sherry]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一座陌生的庄园里醒来，有人给你拿来了仆人的衣服。庄园主人是个吸血鬼，想请你做他的“晚餐客人”。面对他和他那位好斗的管家，你为了熬过这一夜，简直忙得不可开交！

（摘自[url=https://karmic-punishment.itch.io/blood-and-sherry]itch.io[/url]）
